headline: Cyient director Vikas Sehgal ceases role
summary: Vikas Sehgal ceased as Cyient's Independent Director on October 16, 2026, after completing his second five-year term. He also left the ESG and Stakeholders' committees.

headline: Choksi Labs EGM approves convertible warrants
summary: Choksi Laboratories held an EGM on October 17, 2026, to approve the issuance of convertible warrants on a preferential basis. Promoters and allottees abstained from voting.

headline: Camlin Fine Sciences director Kanakia exits
summary: Pradip Kanakia ceased to be Independent Director of Camlin Fine Sciences on October 18, 2026, after completing his five-year term.

headline: Vedanta doubles zinc capacity in SA with $600M
summary: Vedanta Ltd doubled zinc production capacity at its Gamsberg mine in South Africa to 500,000 tonnes. The expansion involved a $600 million investment and was inaugurated by President Ramaphosa.

headline: Oil India signs RSC for Singrauli CBM block
summary: Oil India Limited signed the Revenue Sharing Contract for Special CBM Block SR-ONHP-(CBM)-2026/1 in Singrauli Coalfield on October 15, 2026.

headline: Orissa HC quashes ₹696 Cr demand against JSW Steel
summary: The High Court of Orissa quashed a ₹696 crore demand letter against JSW Steel regarding the Jajang Iron Ore Block. A separate ₹1,472 crore demand was set aside and remitted for fresh review.

headline: Schneider Infra appeal rejected in GST case
summary: Schneider Electric Infrastructure's appeal against excess ITC claim for FY18 rejected. Penalty of ₹5.04 lakh upheld, total liability ₹10.08 lakh plus interest.
